contractSource: Description: "Calculate required UPS capacity based on connected devices. Estimate total power load, con..." Controls: Safety Margin, Power Factor.
groundTruth: Required VA = load (W) × (1 + margin) ÷ power factor; a UPS is chosen at the next standard size at or above it.

cases.note: The default device list holds one 300 W desktop PC; the power factor control is not shown by default and defaults to 0.8.
cases.derivation: 300 W × 1.20 margin = 360 W; ÷ 0.8 PF = 450 VA. The next standard UPS size at or above 450 VA is 500 VA.
